paragraphs.text: Good Shepherd Church of God in Christ will serve a free Thanksgiving dinner from 4:30 to 7:30 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, at 184 W. Bolton St. in Pontotoc. People of all ages are welcome, Pastor Robert Fleming Jr. said Tuesday in an interview on WCBI’s Midday.

Fleming said the dinner grew out of seeing people struggle to get enough food at a time of year often associated with big meals. The church wanted to serve people beyond its own congregation and give neighbors a place to eat together. He invited attendees to bring friends and family.

The church also has limited capacity to deliver meals in the community, Fleming said. Anyone who needs to ask about delivery can reach Good Shepherd at 662-489-2205, the number listed in the Pontotoc Chamber’s directory. The meal at the church is open to everyone.
